question: Where are a hotel within 20 kilometers of IIT Stuart School of Business, Chicago, IL in the northeast direction?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%IIT Stuart School of Business%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 20000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%IIT Stuart School of Business%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
